name: Riya Ahuja
bio: Independent security researcher specialising in IoT network security, anomaly detection, and embedded systems. Interested in bridging gap between ML theory and constrained device deployment.

name: Varun Mehta
bio: Researcher focused on network traffic analysis, deep packet inspection, and graph-based anomaly detection for heterogeneous network environments.

name: Siddharth Kapoor
bio: Research interests span federated learning, privacy-preserving machine learning, and financial fraud detection. Advocate for open, privacy-respecting AI in regulated industries.

name: Priya Nambiar
bio: Works on explainable machine learning systems for high-stakes decision-making, focusing on regulatory compliance and auditability in financial AI.

name: Arjun Trivedi
bio: Systems researcher focused on distributed ML optimisation, gradient compression, and communication-efficient training algorithms.

name: Divya Krishnamurthy
bio: NLP researcher with interest in reasoning capabilities of large language models, systematic literature review methodology, and evaluation of emergent behaviours in foundation models.

name: Aditya Rao
bio: Quantum computing researcher focusing on near-term applications, error correction codes, and the theory-practice gap in NISQ-era quantum devices.

name: Nalini Joshi
bio: Specialises in classical simulation of quantum circuits, syndrome decoding algorithms, and hardware-aware quantum circuit optimisation.

name: Meera Balasubramanian
bio: Computational biologist applying geometric deep learning to structural biology problems. Interests include protein folding, molecular dynamics simulation, and drug-target interaction prediction.
